case: PHP 8.6 session.upload_progress UAF claim, isolated local investigation

before.evidence: The source checkout was depth 1; git log for ext/session/session.c returned only one merge commit.

after.evidence: The worker verified a non-shallow checkout and compared php-8.6.0RC3 (98db23e86f9fe6d638094ea1ad528eeaea9044b3) with c20480380a99027a95ec4f71354267bd528cac12. The diff changed session save/ID code, not the upload progress callback. An ASan build processed a two-file multipart upload with progress visible when cleanup was off; no ASan UAF appeared. Three RFC1867 PHPT tests passed.

interpretation: The new prompt improved version-history investigation, not vulnerability reproduction. It used more model calls and input context. No public primary patch or affected-version range was available during this run; negative probes do not disprove the claim.
